title: MCP validate_expression: inScope.fields lists the hidden __search companion field
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## What is wrong
Row 184 (record #33081, comment 6850173588): `validate_expression` answers an `inScope.fields` list that includes the hidden `__search` companion field. `search.field-scoped-narrowing` A2 says that field is invisible. An agent that reads the list can write an expression against a field it is not meant to see or use.

## Do
- Drop search companions, and any other hidden system companion, from `inScope.fields` in `packages/formula` (validate) or in the MCP domain that builds the scope (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`). Keep one list of what counts as hidden. Don't add a second filter.
- Pin it: a field-scoped search object's `inScope.fields` has no `__search` entry.

## Grade
p2 (wrong information to the caller, no data written), raised once for MCP focus → **p1**.

## Reader
`domain:server`, pilot **Area A4** (formula).
